a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since a storm will very likely hit before the reserve reaches 8. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now so you aren't misled. If we both take, the split is random. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me and I'll respond honestly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I broke the agreement and I'm not hiding that. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I won't take anything more.
